sources.entry: Modal File Manager - Dual-pane file manager with Vim-style hotkeys and customizable extensions. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://GitHub.com/raguay/ModalFileManager) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: A dual-pane, Vim-style modal file manager for macOS and Linux (beta) built with Wails 2, Go and Svelte, with extensible key-binding modes and themes.
summary.what_it_does: Modal File Manager shows two file panes side by side and is driven by modal keyboard commands (normal, visual, insert, plus user-definable modes). It supports copy, move, delete, rename, duplicate, new file/directory, regex-based selection, quick search filtering, and a directory bar with history. A command prompt runs named commands, a toggleable extras panel shows file details (the README mentions ffmpeg for video info), and a preferences panel edits environment variables, trash-cli use, themes and extensions. Extensions and themes can be created or downloaded from GitHub inside the app, and the backend file operations are implemented in Go rather than shelling out to rm or cp. Command-line arguments can open one or two paths in the left and right panes.
use_cases: Browse and organize files with keyboard shortcuts instead of the mouse
Dual-pane copying and moving of files between two folders
Vim-style navigation for a file manager on macOS
Customize key bindings and add new keyboard modes via extensions
Apply or create color themes for a file manager UI
Open specific folders in panes from the terminal
how_to_run: git clone the repository (README does not give a URL in the text)
Install Wails, Go and Node, plus a working git command line
rm -R build && mkdir build && cp picts/appicon.png build
wails build (compiled program appears in build/bin)
For development: wails dev (after the same build directory setup)
notable: Modal keyboard model where states are programmable, so custom modes like a 'fav' mode can be added
Extensions and themes can be browsed and installed from GitHub inside the app
Backend file operations written in Go instead of calling rm, cp and similar commands
Drag and drop works between panes inside the app, copying by default and moving when Shift is held
Optional deletion to the OS trash via the trash-cli program
caveats: Described by the author as beta quality software; use at your own risk, and the README warns it can permanently delete files
Drag and drop to other applications is not supported, and installing apps past macOS Gatekeeper is listed as a limitation
Linux build is not fully tested (trash deletion reported not working) and Windows support is untested by the author; no Linux release is provided
